summary: Set the bombs, demolish buildings, skyscrapers, towers, castles. Smash Cities!
description:
Welcome to "Fake Island: Demolish!" - your ultimate offline city smash game. Get ready to demolish iconic structures worldwide with a simple and satisfying gameplay experience. This demolition game, based on real physics and gravity, lets you destroy various structures, including buildings, skyscrapers, towers, castles, and even fake landmarks. Unleash destruction, wreak havoc, and enjoy the thrill of tearing down the world!

Are you ready for the destruction of the world's famous buildings? Just place dynamites properly and fire. Demolition is now more fun! Smash solar panels and landmarks. This is an offline city smash game.

If you like destruction games and want to destroy cities and destroy buildings you will enjoy our building destruction game. Break houses and enjoy demolition and destruction.

Fake Island: Demolish is a building demolition game based on real physics and gravity. You need to place the TNTs in the available slots in the builds. Buildings, skyscrapers, lighthouses, power plants, industrial structures, dilapidated buildings are just some different types of structures in the game. You also get to destroy world-famous landmarks. They are not real landmarks but fakes of the original ones. Smash city with amazing buildings. Teardown buildings with one of the best games in the world

As a result of successful demolitions; You get contract offers from mayors of world cities. Each new 10 stars brings a new contract to demolish a 'fake landmark' on the Fake Island. If you don't want to wait to get enough stars to play Landmarks, you can unlock them with diamonds and play instantly. Smash solar buildings with this new game.

⭐KEY FEATURES⭐

🏙️ City Smash Galore: 
Demolish city landscapes with a variety of structures, from buildings and skyscrapers to lighthouses and power plants. Tear down dilapidated buildings and iconic landmarks.

💣 Explosive Gameplay:
Place TNT strategically in available slots and witness the spectacular results. The game is a perfect mix of strategy and explosive action. Watch as the destruction unfolds with real physics and gravity at play.

🌐 Worldwide Chaos:
Embark on a global demolition spree! Receive contract offers from mayors of world cities as you accumulate stars. Each milestone unlocks a new opportunity to demolish a fake landmark on the renowned Fake Island.

⭐ Star Power:
Accumulate stars through successful demolitions. Every 10 stars bring exciting new contracts. If you can't wait, use diamonds to unlock and play instantly. It's your chance to be the ultimate demolisher and ruler of destruction.

🕹️ Simple Yet Addictive:
Enjoy a relaxing yet highly addictive gameplay experience. This game is suitable for all ages, making it the perfect choice for family and friends gatherings. Build your demolishing legacy offline, anytime, anywhere.

🚀 Free and Fun:
Download this entertaining game for free and embark on a journey of destruction. It's not just a game; it's a brain exercise wrapped in explosive excitement.

🌐 Offline Domination:
Play without the need for an internet connection. Whether you're on a plane, in a waiting room, or simply offline, the demolition fun never stops.

🌆 Iconic Structures:
Experience the thrill of destroying a variety of iconic structures. From famous landmarks to everyday buildings, each demolition is a unique and satisfying experience.
